payload.text: For hv, cldr-vc's finding 2026-11-04: Intent's generated AGENTS.md has no user block and calls intent/llm/RULES.md and ARCHITECTURE.md 'seeded empty by intent init' even once a project has written them. An agent that reads AGENTS.md alone (Codex, Cursor) misses the project's contract, including Cldr's public-repo rule against personal data. Claude Code loads it through CLAUDE.md's imports, and pplr is in the same state. The fix is Intent's, out of scope here.
